$comment: THE single source of truth. Website, dashboard and post templates read every link and the contract address from here. Change it only via `npm run dashboard` (validates the CA on-chain) or a reviewed commit.
name: CHEK
tickerNote: Brand is CHEK. CHEKD is only the token symbol (owner decision, 01 Oct 2026 UTC — $CHEK was crowded with unrelated tokens).
oneLiner: A Solana meme coin with one rule: every claim comes with a receipt.

x.origin: An existing account owned by the founder, renamed and repurposed for CHEK (verified 01 Oct 2026, 23:20 UTC). It was not created for CHEK; its join date is older than the project.

domain.note: Canonical domain confirmed by the owner. Every other domain (incl. chekcoin.vercel.app and the CHECK-spelled typo) only redirects here.

platform.name: Pump.fun
platform.note: Platform values change. Re-check on launch day; after the mint we publish the real creation transaction and its real cost.

drop.name: CHEK Receipt Drop

x.name: X drop
x.entry: follow @chekcoinsol, repost a drop post, reply to it with your public Solana address, then paste the link to your reply at chekcoinsol.xyz/drop
x.check: the site checks that the link is a public reply to @chekcoinsol, written after the drop opened, that contains a valid Solana address; one entry per X account and per address; follow and repost are asked, not checked

telegram.name: Telegram drop
telegram.entry: subscribe to t.me/chekcoinsol and leave your public Solana address in the comments under the pinned Telegram drop post (or send it to @chekcoinsol_bot) — one address per Telegram account, channel subscribers only

drop.separate: two separate drops with separate lists and separate draws — you can enter both
drop.source: the creator wallet’s own launch buy (bought on the curve like everyone; free allocation stays 0%)
drop.draw_rules: entries close 24 hours after launch; each drop’s winners are picked at random with a published Solana blockhash as the seed, anyone can re-check
drop.send: from the creator wallet within 48 hours after the draw; every transfer published as an on-chain receipt
drop.condition: only if $CHEKD launches; in each drop the airdrop goes to the first valid entries in order, the draw is among all valid entries
drop.never: no claim site, no wallet connect, no signing, no fees, no DMs from us
